capabilities: group aliases that appear in multiple files into duplicate lists
open a duplicate note or its source file by clicking an alias
highlight and remove aliases in Reading and Source mode
view aliases generated for an individual file
customize alias matching with regex exclude and replace rules
extras: The README includes a disclaimer that the plugin is used at the author takes no responsibility for data loss, and lists an unfinished pipeline item (search for aliases).
problem: Obsidian does not surface notes that collide through aliases or similar filenames, so duplicate notes can accumulate unnoticed and fragment links.
summary: Duplicate-note finder that groups notes sharing similar aliases or filenames and lets you open and rename them.
